manifestDescription.message: Keep Google in its own orbit. Isolate Google, YouTube and every Google service in a dedicated container with tracker blocking.

commandMoveIn.message: Move the current tab into the Orbis container

commandMoveOut.message: Move the current tab out of the Orbis container

menuAlways.message: Always open this site in Orbis

menuNever.message: Never open this site in Orbis

menuMoveOut.message: Move this tab out of Orbis

popupBlockedHint.message: Google trackers stopped before they loaded.

popupAllowSite.message: Allow Google resources on this site

popupTempHint.message: Containment paused here — about $1 min left.

popupVerdictInside.message: Non-Google site currently inside the container.

popupVerdictNormal.message: Not a Google site — browsing normally.

popupBlockHintOff.message: Tracker blocking is switched off in settings.

popupBlockHintAllowed.message: You have allowed Google resources on this site.

popupBlockHintNone.message: No Google trackers found on this page.

popupBlockAgain.message: Block Google resources on this site again

popupUnreachableDetail.message: Could not reach the extension: $1. Close and reopen this popup.

popupUnreachable.message: Could not reach the extension. Close and reopen this popup.

optionsSubtitle.message: Every Google-owned site is isolated in its own Firefox Container, so Google cookies never touch the rest of your browsing.

optionsRenameHint.message: Renaming updates the existing container in place; your cookies and logins stay intact.

optionsBlockingTitle.message: Blocking Google trackers on other websites

optionsBlockingIntro.message: Google code is embedded across much of the web. Even without cookies, loading it tells Google your IP address and which page you are reading. Blocking stops the request before it is sent.

optionsBlockingOff.message: Off. Load every embedded Google resource as normal.

optionsBlockingStandard.message: Standard, recommended. Block Google analytics, advertising and social widgets on sites that are not Google. Fonts, maps, sign-in, reCAPTCHA and embedded videos keep working.

optionsBlockingStrict.message: Strict. Also block fonts, hosted script libraries, maps and embedded players. This will visibly break some websites. Sign-in and reCAPTCHA are still allowed, so you cannot be locked out of an account.

optionsShowBadge.message: Show the number blocked on the toolbar icon

optionsAllowlistHint.message: Sites where Google resources are allowed to load normally:

optionsUnwrap.message: Unwrap Google redirect links (google.com/url?q=…) so external sites open outside the container

optionsOAuth.message: Let “Sign in with Google” on third-party sites work (the handshake runs in the container, the callback lands back on the site)

optionsReleaseNonGoogle.message: Push non-Google pages opened inside the container back out

optionsCollectStats.message: Keep local statistics (never leaves your device)

optionsUseSync.message: Mirror settings through Firefox Sync when available

optionsDomainSetsHint.message: The domain database ships with the extension and needs no network access. Domain lists live in the repository under src/domains/.

optionsAlwaysHint.message: Extra hosts that should always open in the Google container. Paste several patterns at once, one per line.

optionsNeverHint.message: Highest priority. Use for sites that must stay in normal browsing even when they redirect through Google. Paste several patterns at once, one per line.

optionsExceptionsHint.message: Sites that must never be pulled into the container, even when they match Google. Disabled exceptions are kept but ignored.

optionsBackupHint.message: Versioned, human-readable JSON. Imports are validated and sanitised.

optionsResetHint.message: Restores defaults. Your container and its cookies are not deleted.

optionsLogHint.message: The most recent decisions the engine made: every action taken (contain, release, unwrap) plus ignores worth knowing about. Stored locally only, never synced or sent anywhere.

setDescGoogle.message: google.com, all country domains, Gmail, Drive, Maps, the .google gTLD and more.

setDescYoutube.message: youtube.com, youtu.be, youtube-nocookie.com, localized YouTube domains, video CDNs.

setDescTrackers.message: doubleclick.net, google-analytics.com, googletagmanager.com… Off by default: top-level visits are usually ad click-throughs belonging to the originating site.

setDescHosting.message: appspot.com, web.app, firebaseapp.com… Off by default: these host unrelated third-party apps.

optionsResetConfirm.message: Reset all Orbis settings to their defaults?

optionsSiteStatsHint.message: Where the counters above came from. Hostnames only, stored locally, never synced or exported. The oldest sites drop off after 200 entries.

optionsTempHint.message: Sites where containment pauses for a while and resumes on its own. Add one from the popup while visiting the site.

optionsTempRemoveTitle.message: End the temporary allowance for $1 now

onboardingSubtitle.message: Keep Google in its own orbit. Private, fast, invisible.

onboardingStep1Body.message: Orbis creates a separate container orbit for Google – an isolated space where Google's cookies stay locked inside.

onboardingStep1Body2.message: You stay signed into Google and it works normally, but other sites can't see your Google session, and Google can't see your other browsing.

onboardingOrbitBody.message: Google in its own box, everything else outside. No cross-tracking.

onboardingStep2Body.message: One hotkey, zero clicks – feels native.

onboardingHotkey1Desc.message: New Orbis tab – Google in its own orbit

onboardingShortcutsHint.message: Change shortcuts: Add-ons Manager → Gear → Manage Extension Shortcuts

onboardingMouseBody.message: Toolbar button shows if page is protected, right-click any link → Open in Orbis, or move tabs in/out.

onboardingStep3Body.message: Separating cookies is half the job. Orbis also blocks Google trackers on other sites.

onboardingStep3Hint.message: Fonts, maps, embedded videos, reCAPTCHA and Sign-in with Google are left alone to avoid breaking sites. Strict mode in settings blocks more, but sign-in stays allowed so you never get locked out.

onboardingStep4Body.message: That's it – no complicated configuration needed. It just works.

onboardingStep4Body2.message: Orbis automatically puts Google in its orbit, blocks trackers elsewhere, and never makes network requests of its own.

onboardingTip.message: Tip: Extension is invisible in background – no telemetry, no tracking, everything stays on your device. Works great with uBlock Origin.
